info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Gap Analysis Submission API
info.description: The Gap Analysis Submission API facilitates the process of submitting gap analysis models within the banking domain. This endpoint allows users to upload detailed analyses that identify discrepancies between current and desired performance levels in banking operations. Designed primarily for analysts and banking professionals, this API supports improved decision-making by helping organizations pinpoint areas for enhancement. Users can leverage this functionality for both regulatory compliance and operational efficiency initiatives.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new gap analysis by providing the necessary data in the request body. It is used to evaluate and identify gaps in various processes or data sets.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new gap analysis. It should include all necessary information required for the analysis.
